name: Hate Squad

tenures.source: Devo's profile: 'Devo and the Hate Squad. The first stable in the ESW'; the Hall of Fame says Horance Pinkerton came to the NYCW to join Devo in their quest for total control, and the 13 January 2003 listing has Eddie learn 'who and what the Hate Skwad was all about'. The membership of Pinkerton is read from the Hall of Fame entry and their tag matches.

caption: The first stable in the fed, Devo and his running buddy Horace Pinkerton, who held the first Television title and a World title in 2003.

name: Happy Happy Fun Team

tenures.source: The 22 October 2003 listing: 'the HHFT team is formed'; the Hall of Fame calls Zander Thrash 'the leader to the Happy happy joy joy team with Larcen Night' and Larcen Night's profile says he ran with Zander Thrash in the Happy Happy Fun Team.

caption: Zander Thrash and Larcen Night, formed in October 2003 and winners of the 2004 Tag Team titles at Bruise Cruise 2.

name: The Meds

tenures.source: The 2008 championships history: 'The Meds started to take over the ESW when Prozac beat Widowmaker for the Survivor title' on 12 February 2007, and Ritilin's win at the same show made 'The Meds a team to watch out for'; Prozac and Ritilin won the 2008 Tag Team titles.

caption: Prozac and Ritilin, who won the Survivor and Television titles at Bloody Hell in February 2007 and the 2008 Tag Team titles.

name: Femme Fatales

tenures.source: Jada Kaine's profile says she and Helena started the Femme Fatales; the 2010 profile of RC Pride speaks of 'the women she despises, the Femme Fatales'.

caption: Helena Kreuz and Jada Kaine, who started the women's group the fed's later profiles call the Femme Fatales.

identity.note: The same name stands on another wing's record; nothing on this wing's pages ties the two.

name: Material Girls

tenures.source: Ebony Fairchild's profile: she and Rebella DeCesare work 'as one of the most cohesive female units in the ESW known simply as The Material Girls'.

caption: Rebella DeCesare and Ebony Fairchild, best friends who work as one of the fed's women's units in 2010.
